integrity: Complete analytic proof supplied for the new perturbation construction, with explicitly named classical fixed-point and localization theorems as imported literature. No independent audit or formal certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The ambient norm is explicitly uniformly convex but may be nonsmooth, so smooth-renorming analogues are unproved. Only the displayed family, not all near-Hilbert norms, is covered. Exact Hilbert norm beta=0 does not have this property. Historical priority remains subject to independent checking.
title: Arbitrarily Hilbert-close uniformly convex renormings with an unbounded nonexpansive fixed-point set
